payload.claim:
Revisit the BUY under any of these conditions:
- Rolling-twelve-month EBIT margin falls below 12%.
- Full-year 2026 EBIT margin guidance is cut below 13%.
- Management signals that the electrified melting lines are delayed or will not hit cost targets, such as grid-connection slippage or capex overruns beyond €750M without matching capacity.
- Local-currency revenue growth turns negative for two consecutive quarters on a European new-build relapse.
- The integrity gate escalates beyond Flag.
Conversely, conviction would rise if TTM EBIT margin recovers above 15% while capex remains at or above €750M, which would show the investment programme earns above its cost of capital.

prediction.reasoning: The TTM EBIT margin to June 2026 is 13.97% and already excludes the Russian write-off, and management reaffirmed 13-14% for FY2026. I allow for the Q2 slippage to 12.9% and set the bar just below the guidance floor. This tests the thesis that the FY2025 4.59% was a one-off: it says normalised margins stay roughly three times the depressed level the screen and the 3.2% implied growth are anchored on.
